name: Kami-sama no Hanayome
source:
Yuri, our orphaned protagonist, sacrifices herself to the Water Dragon one day due to a water shortage. This is when the story begins.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11307]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
主角尤里是個孤兒。有一天，因為水源短缺，她將自己獻祭給水龍。故事便由此開始。

［譯自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11307]Novelgame[/url]］
